inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL expression reports the explicit collation and coercibility of one string expression.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced independently authored scalar regression retaining COLLATION and COERCIBILITY over one explicitly binary-collated string literal; table setup and report rows are removed.

fixture_notes: One fixed string literal isolates explicit collation-name reporting and the strongest coercibility rank.
determinism_notes: The literal and collation are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT COLLATION('probe' COLLATE utf8mb4_bin) AS explicit_collation, COERCIBILITY('probe' COLLATE utf8mb4_bin) AS explicit_coercibility
